_README: Identification of MDU, the 'schema authority' named in the VANA authority triple and in Arya's contract approval gate. MDU is NOT a person - it is a live BHIV registry service.
_question: Arya, 2026-08-24: 'Do you have an idea about who has authority to confirm MDU?'
_finding: MDU = BHIV Intelligence Data Universe Registry v1.0.0, a LIVE BHIV service. It is a SYSTEM, not a person. That is why no individual could be named.

service.openapi: HTTP 401 Unauthorized - authentication required, no token held by Group 3

corroboration.source: ../day2/Group1-2-4 day1 and 2 reports/karan group 4 reports/Karan-group4-tasks.txt  (workspace root, not Day6/)
corroboration.says: MDU listed under the Insight ecosystem alongside InsightCore / InsightFlow / InsightBridge. 'Official Name: BHIV Intelligence Data Universe Registry v1.0.0', 'Registry ID: BHIV-IDU-REGISTRY-V1', 'Runtime Status: LIVE AND OPERATIONAL', 'MDU OpenAPI requires authentication'. Classification REUSE / ADAPT. Blocker noted: 'MDU authentication / bearer token provisioning'.
'Insight ecosystem (Core / Flow / Bridge / MDU) | V3 | All four live; InsightBridge + MDU documented'. V3 is Group 3's highest evidence tier.
'TMS = strategy, GC = governance, MDU = schemas/provenance' - the triple names FUNCTIONS and SYSTEMS, not individuals.

_what_is_NOT_established: WHO operates or administers the MDU registry within BHIV. No owner, maintainer or contact is named in any task document, contract, inbound artifact or Group 3 record.
Whether 'schema-authority approval' was ever intended as a human sign-off at all, as opposed to registration of a canonical schema in the MDU registry.
Group 3 holds no MDU bearer token, so it could not register anything even if that were the intent.
_consequence_for_the_amendment_gate: The gate as written - 'contract-owner approval PLUS schema-authority/MDU approval' - cannot be satisfied by a signature, because MDU is a registry service. Either the requirement means registration rather than approval, or it means approval by whoever operates MDU - and that person is named nowhere in the available record.
